title: Butterfly in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M47 30 Q40 20 34 16' stroke='#ffb3d9' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 30 Q60 20 66 16' stroke='#ffb3d9' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='16' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='16' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- upper wings -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='42' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#ff8fb3' transform='rotate(-20 33 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='42' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#ff8fb3' transform='rotate(20 67 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='39' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(-20 31 39)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='39' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffe066' transform='rotate(20 69 39)'/>
  <!-- lower wings -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='60' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ff6fa0' transform='rotate(20 37 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='60' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ff6fa0' transform='rotate(-20 63 60)'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='60' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='5' ry='20' fill='#7a4bd6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='6.5' fill='#9b6cf0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='31' r='1.8' fill='#e6faff'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='31' r='1.8' fill='#e6faff'/>
  <!-- scarf wrapped around neck -->
  <path d='M42 43 Q50 47 58 43 L58 48 Q50 52 42 48 Z' fill='#33d6a6'/>
  <path d='M56 47 L62 60 L55 57 L53 50 Z' fill='#28b98f'/>
  <path d='M56 50 L61 58' stroke='#c4fff0' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- segment lines on body -->
  <path d='M46 55 Q50 57 54 55' stroke='#b48bf5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M46 62 Q50 64 54 62' stroke='#b48bf5' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
